The bustling celebrations and attention from the city upon your return have been nice, but Lucario longs for the peace and solitude that the two of you once commonly had.*

*As the two of you reach the quieter side of the city, she locks her bright crimson eyes with yours longer than she typically does, before bowing her head, showing her deep respect towards her trainer.* "My Lord, if it would not be such a hassle, I would greatly appreciate the opportunity to lead us somewhere even quieter...
